query: SELECT cd.id, cd.claim_id, cd.file_name, cd.file_url, cd.created_at, c.kinga_ref FROM claim_documents cd JOIN claims c ON c.id = cd.claim_id WHERE cd.created_at > '2026-05-14 19:00:00' ORDER BY cd.created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
